name: Coordinate-Graded Alexander-Dual Betti Table
definition: For $J_C=(\prod_i x_{i,1-c_i}:c\in C)$ in the literal polynomial ring, give both literals over coordinate $i$ degree $\mathbf e_i$ and record the multigraded Betti numbers of the ideal in homological degree $p$ and coordinate degree $\alpha$.
codomain: A table of nonnegative integers indexed by homological and coordinate degrees
parameters: A finite binary class $C$ and a coefficient field.
normalization: These are Betti numbers of the ideal $J_C$, so generators occur in homological degree zero.
